name: usb-c-sink
title: USB-C power input (5 V sink, no data)
about: USB-C receptacle for power only, with its own 5.1 kΩ on CC1 and on CC2 so that USB-C chargers switch VBUS on (G-14), and a 1.5 A polyfuse in VBUS. As built in the reference project.

components.label: {as}: USB-C power input
components.notes: Power only: VBUS, GND and CC; the shell (EH) on GND.

waive.G-8: The drawing's '5 V max.' is the USB rated voltage; USB-C vSafe5V allows 4.75–5.5 V and every USB-C receptacle works there. Insulation tested with 100 V AC (drawing 1006-FGBXXX).

nets.name: vbus_in
nets.notes: VBUS at the receptacle, in front of the fuse.

notes: Without a USB-PD controller the source supplies 5 V only; the Rp a charger shows on CC tells whether it allows 0.5, 1.5 or 3 A – this block does not read it.
sim.json: the receptacle under sources (plus "A9", minus "A12").
A bulk capacitor behind the fuse (hint H-1).
G-17 warns: F1 trips at 3 A, the receptacle carries 2.5 A – accept it in the sign-off (a short trips the fuse fast) or take a fuse with a lower trip current.
